description: This Java source file defines the final class LabelManagerFactory, responsible for managing label files, loading component names, parsing XML resource files, and providing access to label information within the Apache OFBiz framework's web tools component. It includes methods for retrieving label files, matching labels based on specified criteria, updating label values, and handling localization data.

classes.name: LabelManagerFactory
classes.description: A utility class in the OFBiz framework for managing label resources, loading component and label data, and providing label information for internationalization purposes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Singleton-like method to create and retrieve the shared instance of LabelManagerFactory, loading component names and label files if necessary.

methods.name: loadComponentNames
methods.description: Loads all component names from the OFBiz component configuration into the static set for quick lookup.

methods.name: loadLabelFiles
methods.description: Loads label resource files from all classpath info objects into the static map for later access.

methods.name: findMatchingLabels
methods.description: Parses label XML files to find labels matching specified component, filename, key, and locale criteria, optionally filtering for labels not used or duplicated.

methods.name: getLabelFile
methods.description: Retrieves a LabelFile object for a given filename.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Returns the map of label information objects (LabelInfo).

methods.name: getLocalesFound
methods.description: Returns a set of all locales encountered during label parsing.

methods.name: getFilesFound
methods.description: Returns all LabelFile objects found in the classpath.

methods.name: getComponentNamesFound
methods.description: Returns all component names detected in the project.

methods.name: getLabelsList
methods.description: Returns a set of all label keys available in the loaded label data.

methods.name: getDuplicatedLocalesLabels
methods.description: Returns the number of labels with duplicated locale entries.

methods.name: getDuplicatedLocalesLabelsList
methods.description: Provides a list of LabelInfo objects that have duplicated locale entries.

methods.name: updateLabelValue
methods.description: Updates or creates label entries for specified locales, values, and comments associated with a particular label key.
